blocks.html: An EduBud Chapter unites members in their school community to advance our mission and values through local initiatives. Our chapters work on a wide range of projects aimed at closing educational gaps through advocacy, education, and leadership.

blocks.html: Community is built through connection, collaboration, and shared experiences. As an EduBud chapter leader, you’ll bring students and community members together while creating opportunities for service, partnership, and inclusion.

blocks.html: Leadership is more than guiding others. It’s inspiring action and creating change. By starting an EduBud chapter, you’ll develop real-world leadership skills while organizing initiatives, building community, and empowering others to lead.
